fields.summary: For Indian students booking US visa appointments: you must schedule two separate dates on usvisascheduling.com, starting with OFC biometrics before your consular interview.
A comparison for Indian families funding a US master's degree, contrasting secured SBI INR loans against collateral-free USD loans from Prodigy and Mpower.
Guidance for Indian 3-year bachelor's graduates (B.Sc, B.Com, BCA): over 60% of top US universities accept three-year degrees from NAAC Grade A accredited colleges.
Written for Indian STEM applicants pursuing research assistantships: securing an RA or TA position can award in-state tuition waivers and monthly stipends up to $2,500.
Explains how Indian master's students can work 20 hours weekly as graduate assistants to earn monthly stipends and qualify for in-state tuition waivers at public universities.
Helps Indian F-1 students plan off-campus internships: you must complete one full academic year (nine months) in the US before becoming eligible for paid CPT authorization.
An overview for Indian families planning US master's studies, detailing tuition ranges from $22,000 at public state universities to over $35,000 at private institutions.
Walks Indian applicants through Form DS-160, detailing why personal history, SEVIS ID, and university school codes must match your official Form I-20 exactly.
Prep strategy for Indian students taking the Duolingo English Test: costs roughly $59 and delivers certified test scores to US universities within 48 hours.
Step-by-step roadmap for Indian offer holders preparing for the 3-to-5 minute F-1 visa interview and satisfying INA Section 214(b) non-immigrant intent rules.
Interview preparation for Indian visa applicants: learn how to answer common consular questions concisely and demonstrate strong ties to India to avoid 214(b) refusals.
Advises Indian applicants choosing between Fall and Spring intakes: Fall students gain summer CPT internship eligibility after two semesters, unlike Spring arrivals.
Preparation advice for shortlisted Indian scholars facing the 20-minute USIEF panel interview in New Delhi for the Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowship.
Covers the Fulbright-Nehru Fellowship for Indian graduates, detailing full tuition coverage, monthly stipends, and the mandatory two-year home residence rule on J-1 visas.
Shows Indian students how university marks and 10-point CGPA scores translate to the US 4.0 GPA scale under WES and AACRAO credit-weighted conversion standards.
Navigates application systems like GradCAS, ApplyTexas, and Slate for Indian applicants, outlining departmental fees from $65 to $150 per university submission.
Directory for Indian master's applicants seeking GRE waivers: discover top US universities with test-optional policies that save the $220 exam registration fee.
Study blueprint for Indian engineering students targeting 165 to 170 on GRE Quant, using high percentiles to strengthen admissions profiles with moderate undergraduate CGPAs.
Preparation methods for Indian students targeting 155+ in GRE Verbal and 4.5+ in AWA, focusing on contextual logic and essay structure to reach a 320+ combined score.
Explores self-petitioned US permanent residency options for Indian STEM graduates, including EB-2 NIW and EB-1A pathways that bypass employer PERM labor certification.
